'''''Ranger''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

When the [[Habassa]] evacuated the Rebel B-wing assembly. The Alliance entered negotiations to gain a new ally against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Habassa were skeptical however, so an opportunity arose when Intelligence discovered the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Frigate]] ''[[Mayhem]]'' was to rendezvous with three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] [[Strider (freighter)|''Strider'']], ''[[Treader]]'' and [[Walker (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Walker'']]. The Alliance sent an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] and a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], which was piloted by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] to disable the ''Walker'', which carried Habassan [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and destroyed the other freighters. The '''Ranger''' arrived to board and liberate the slaves but as soon as it docked, the frigate ''Mayham'' arrived and tried to prevent the liberation with [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|Bombers]], but Farlander held of the fighters long enough for '''Ranger''' to complete the operation and retreat to Alliance space.
